description: This source file contains unit tests for the SbPlayerGetAudioConfiguration function, verifying its behavior under various scenarios such as normal operation, no input, and multiple seeks. It also defines a custom operator== for SbMediaAudioConfiguration and a test fixture class.

classes.name: SbPlayerGetAudioConfigurationTest
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing SbPlayerGetAudioConfiguration, including methods to read and validate configurations.

methods.name: ReadAudioConfigurations
methods.description: Reads all available audio configurations from the player fixture, appending valid configurations to the provided vector.

methods.name: AssertConfigurationIsValid
methods.description: Checks if a given SbMediaAudioConfiguration has valid connector and coding_type values, and non-negative number of channels.
